verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs cover program mechanics (KYC bypass/exempt paths, card issuance, authorization rules, spend limits, sandbox) implying it handles compliance/program management so founders needn't become a bank, and community commentary notes issuing-as-a-service lowers the cost of building neobanks. However, there is no explicit mention of BIN sponsorship or network membership being provided by Lithic, and no documented time-from-signup-to-first-live-card metric anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/network membership claims, a documented signup-to-live-card timeline, and independent confirmation of program-management turnkey experience.
